agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has two massive bodies (1 and 2, ~17.7 mass, G=3.22) approaching to 0.34 (softening 0.3) at step 26 while moving at ~11-12 speed. The leapfrog integrator uses fixed 6 substeps per outer dt=0.026, which is insufficient to resolve the strong, rapidly varying softened force at this close separation. Kinetic rises from 1865 at step 25 to 2683 at step 26 and potential deepens from -1762 to -2730, causing total energy to swing from +102 to -47 (Δ≈127, allowed ≈108), violating energy_conserved. Reducing dt to 0.005 while keeping steps identical resolves the integration error and removes the violation, confirming the cause is temporal resolution.
